hooks.name: player_fish_v2
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge's ItemFishedEvent fires after the loot roll, in FishingHook.retrieve; Bukkit's PlayerFishEvent with getHand)

rust_summary: a player's fishing rod with the hand that holds it, cancellable (`native_player_fish_v2`).
doc_summary: `native_player_fish_v2(player, name, state, hand, cancel)`: `native_player_fish` with the rod's hand (the hand used for a cast or reel-in, Bukkit's `PlayerFishEvent.getHand`; for a bite the hand holding the rod, main hand first), asked right after v1 with the same `cancel`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_fish_v2@.
